signature.name: VTask.copy
signature.type: {R : Type u_2} -> {A : Type u_3} -> [CommSemiring R] -> [StarRing R] -> [Semiring A] -> [StarRing A] -> [Algebra R A] -> [StarModule R A] -> (S : StarSubalgebra R A) -> (s : Set A) -> (hs : s = ↑S) -> StarSubalgebra R A

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: The function is total given its explicit proof argument hs; there are no junk-value conventions because any call must supply a proof that s equals the carrier of S, leaving no room for degenerate or out-of-domain inputs.

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} {A : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [StarRing R] [Semiring A] [StarRing A] [Algebra R A] [StarModule R A] (S T : StarSubalgebra R A) (s : Set A) (hs : s = ↑S), VTask.copy S s hs ≤ T ↔ S ≤ T
